name: Band Hip Flexor March
steps: Loop a mini resistance band around the arches of both feet and stand tall with light hand support if needed.
Brace your core, keep your standing leg straight, and lock your glute tight on the stance side.
Drive one knee smoothly upward against the band until your thigh rises above hip height with your foot flexed.
Lower your foot slowly back to the floor under control and alternate legs on each repetition.
tips: Keep your torso completely upright instead of leaning backward or rounding your lower back to lift higher.
Pause briefly at the top of each drive before lowering slowly against band tension.
